newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares down in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares down in Beirut.

text.p: Solidere shares eased slightly on Wednesday as A shares fell to $114.25 from Tuesday's $114.75 and B shares also fell to $117.625 from $117.875.
Turnover was 16,427 shares from 17,964 on Tuesday and value was $1,893,834 from $2,082,277.
There was no trade in the four other companies listed on the Beirut Stock Exchange: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit, and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.09 percent to 83.61 and the BLOM stock index fell 0.26 percent to 976.81.
